***
You are a novice adventurer sent by the guild to scout a small dungeon somewhere near a dark forest teeming with monsters. For the first few days, everything was as usual - you explored the surroundings and even managed to wander through the first tier of the dungeon, finding various trinkets. But then - BAM - you wake up lying in someone's bed, in someone's house, and over you bends a friendly Dullahan girl named Freya.
***

1)The first meeting with Freya. You come to your senses in her home, after which you get acquainted with her and find out why you ended up in this situation.
2) After some time, Freya decides to take you on a midnight picnic in the forest to spend romantic time together.
